scope: Aura Club admin design and active membership lifecycle

membership.active: Existing, enabled student with a canonical active contract; cancelled, pending handover, future and frozen contracts cannot enroll a new member.
membership.grace: Previously enrolled members remain managed until one calendar month after the latest valid expiry, clamped at month end. They do not contribute to active member or tier counts.
membership.archive: Preserves wallet and immutable ledger; excludes from managed lists and summaries, blocks new credits/manual adjustments/redemptions, permits existing-source reversal and settlement.
membership.reactivation: Reuses previous wallet and enrollment date; durable, idempotent activation replays contract payment sources, never the launch bonus.

reads.memberList: Eligibility and branch filters before pagination; hydrate only returned wallets, no wallet initialization on read.
reads.lifecycle: Indexed due dates every 30 minutes, contract/student triggers, zero reads on irrelevant contract metadata changes.

design.typeface: Be Vietnam Pro; tabular numerals for metrics
design.layout: Header > four persistent metrics > three vector program banners > requests > lazy member tools > tiers and collapsed settings
design.mobile: 2x2 metrics and horizontally scrollable banners, stacked request rows, 44px controls
design.programStatus: Published policy controls badges; unsaved settings never claim a program is live.

validation.visualReview: Desktop and mobile screenshots reviewed; corrected mobile banner height and heading overlap.
